'''Kaylah Taprish''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] more than a hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Mandalorian Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture. Taprish took a liking to the native and nearly-extinct [[Vrake (species)|vrake]], the distinctive head crest and pattern of which reminded her of her [[Kaylah Taprish's uncle|favorite uncle]], and spent five years studying and crossbreeding them. Taprish then released a dozen new colonies into the wild, restoring their population, though the vrakes soon became fiercely territorial.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kaylah Taprish was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the vrake in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion released for the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
